observations.sentinel1_sar: Copernicus S1 GRD VV backscatter, IW mode
observations.source: GEE reduceRegions, -3dB anomaly threshold, JRC permanent water mask

event_level_validation.note: An S1 image is a flood EVENT if >2% of district cells are flooded. Model WARNED if district mean_prob >= 0.10 in the 72h preceding the overpass.

cell_level_validation.note: Cell-level metrics are not the right measure for a 72h early-warning system (temporal mismatch between peak_probability and instantaneous SAR snapshot). Shown for completeness only.

notes: 2025 season (out-of-sample): 73 S1 images, 68 flood events — F1=0.885 at threshold 0.10.
Model generalises well out-of-sample; 2025 was not used to tune any thresholds.
13 missed events cluster in early-season convective storms (brief, intense) and 2 dates with missing backfill data.
11 false alarms over a full monsoon season ≈ 1 per 10 days.
